findings.issue: Route totals exclude quest time. Every quest step carries 0 hours because no verified fact gives quest durations (plan assumption; tools/xp.py uses est_hours, which no quest step has). Safest has 2 quest steps (S01, S02); balanced 7 (S01-S06, S12); fastest 7 (S01-S06, S22). The 228.2 / 222.86 / 209.85 h totals are training hours only.
findings.recommendation: The guide must state next to every route total: "route totals exclude quest time" and label the totals as training hours.

findings.owner: writer/editor (strategist for wording of the route comparison)
findings.issue: The safest-vs-balanced gap (228.2 - 222.86 = 5.34 h) is not a like-for-like time saving. It decomposes into 4.29 h from Rellekka instead of Pollnivneach at 80-90 (S13 67.193 h vs S11 71.479 h) and 1.05 h less Falador training (S08 1.046 h vs 2.096 h) because five extra quests (S03 Icthlarin's Little Helper, S04 A Tail of Two Cats, S05 Underground Pass, S06 Regicide, S12 The Fremennik Trials) add 28,562.4 Agility XP at 0 hours. If those five quests take more than about 1.05 h in total, the quest block costs time rather than saving it; if they take more than about 5.34 h, balanced is slower overall than safest. No fact gives their durations, so the direction of the comparison cannot be confirmed. The same caveat applies to fastest vs safest (5 extra quests, 18.35 h gap, mostly the Werewolf course).
findings.recommendation: Do not present balanced as '5.3 h faster' than safest. Present training hours only, show the decomposition (Rellekka 80-90 saves about 4.3 h of training; the quest block replaces about 1.05 h of Falador training plus unknown quest time), and justify the extra quests by their other value (Rellekka access, unlocks) rather than by time. Not a fail: the arithmetic is correct and the plan discloses quest time as 0; it becomes misleading only if the guide drops this caveat.

findings.issue: Seers' 60-70 (S09) uses 40,000 XP/h, the low end of F-1017's no-teleport range (40,000-44,000), but F-1017's own caveat says the course page's lap times while still failing (about 75 s at 60-65, 55 s at 65-70) imply roughly 27,000-37,000 XP/h and advises planning the low end or below at 60-65. Recomputed at those lap times (570 XP per lap): 6.42 h for 60-65 + 7.72 h for 65-70 = about 14.1 h, versus 11.59 h in calc.json, about 2.5 h more on safest and balanced. It does not change the safest-vs-balanced ordering (both routes use S09).
findings.recommendation: Present S09 hours as an estimate that may run about 2.5 h longer while laps still fail; optionally plan S09 at the caveat rate.

findings.issue: Fastest route S23 (Werewolf 60-90) uses 55,000 XP/h, inside F-1065's 50,000-65,000, but F-1065's caveat says deathslide fails cut the rate (and are dangerous at 48 HP). The 92.2 h figure may be optimistic; the route is shown for comparison only.

The Fremennik Trials' 2,812.4 Agility XP is added as 2,812 on the Agility track (0.4 XP truncated); Defence is carried as 2,812.4 = level 16 (tools/xp.py level 2812.4 -> 16; level 17 needs 3,115). No effect on any level or count.

Step hours are computed as XP still needed / XP per hour, not actions x XP per action / XP per hour; the overshoot of the last lap is not timed. The difference is at most 0.015 h per step (e.g. safest S08 2.096 h vs 2.111 h). Negligible.

tools/xp.py checks requirements only for the target skill (Agility). I checked the routed non-Agility skill requirements against brief.json stats: S01 Thieving 20 (owner 24), S05 Ranged 25 (56), S06 Crafting 10 (21), S22 Crafting 20 (21) and Thieving 25: owner Thieving 24 (at least 7,028 XP) plus S01's 2,500 Thieving XP gives at least 9,528 XP = level 26 (tools/xp.py), and S01 precedes S22 on the fastest route. Quest prerequisites are in route order (S05 before S06, S03 before S04); whether those prerequisite links are correct is the facts/strategist lane, not re-verified here.

Start XP 212,733 comes from the Hardcore Worlds hiscores, which refresh on logout; if the owner has trained since, every total is slightly overstated (conservative). Also: jobs/agility-1-99-20261119/calc-draft.json is an unsealed file with the same sha256 as calc.json; it was not used.

sanity_checks.check: 6. Action counts and supplies recomputed independently
sanity_checks.detail: No route has supplies (supplies=[] on every step), so supply totals are trivially 0. Recomputed every train step's actions as ceil((xp(until_level) - start_xp) / xp_per_action) with level XP from tools/xp.py xp (60=273,742; 65=449,428; 70=737,627; 80=1,986,068; 90=5,346,332; 99=13,034,431). Examples: safest S08 ceil(57,009/586)=98; balanced S13 ceil(3,359,673/780)=4,308; fastest S23 ceil(5,072,205/730)=6,949; safest S14 ceil(7,687,870/889)=8,648. All 17 train steps, all hours and route totals (actions 14,738 / 15,222 / 15,651) match calc.json.
